data.content:
The Leões entered Matchday 3 with 6 points after beating Galatasaray 3-1 at home and winning 2-0 at Lens, and they had won their last 5 home league-phase games. LASK, making their league-phase debut under Dietmar Kühbauer, had 0 points and had conceded 7 goals in 2 games. Sporting coach Rui Borges sat on 8 Champions League wins, level with Rúben Amorim‘s club record.

### Sporting vs LASK Injuries and Team News [...] Sporting were missing 3 players, and LASK lost 2 to fresh injuries with 3 more left off the UEFA list. LASK captain Sascha Horvath (thigh) was a question mark.

   Sporting out:Zeno Debast (muscle), Nuno Santos (long-term) and a third player with a thigh injury.
   LASK out or doubtful: two players with muscle and shoulder injuries, plus three not registered with UEFA, one of them recovering from a torn ACL.
